title: Identify the Anchor
description: A player wants to turn on-ledger USDC into a bank deposit. The wallet hands the request to an anchor. Before signing, the player has to know which part of the Stellar ecosystem actually performs that conversion.

content.prompt: What is the primary role of an anchor in the Stellar ecosystem?
options: On and off ramp between Stellar assets and off-chain value
Validate and close ledgers for the network
Mint the native XLM asset on demand
Store NFT metadata for Soroban contracts

solution: On and off ramp between Stellar assets and off-chain value
hint: Anchors bridge Stellar and traditional finance: they accept deposits and pay out withdrawals in currencies or assets that live outside the ledger. Validators and the protocol itself do different jobs. Documentation: https://developers.stellar.org/docs/learn/fundamentals/anchors
author: StellarHunts Core

testCases.title: Anchors are on and off ramps
testCases.description: The service converts between Stellar assets and off-chain value.
